scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.admin.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('index.html','dist/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('admin.html','dist/admin.html'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module'}))"
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.admin.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module'}))" && node --test "dist/**/*.test.js"
